document.h: Cover Letter – Application to Alan (Fullstack Software Engineer – Global Architecture)

section.p: I am applying for the Fullstack Software Engineer role in the Global Architecture team. I have spent 25+ years building and operating business-critical platforms where multiple domains, teams, and systems must converge into coherent, maintainable software. I particularly enjoy the kind of work you describe: transforming local implementations into global building blocks, removing cross-team technical blockers, and making complex systems simpler to develop and safer to run.

In my recent roles, I delivered integration-heavy services and high-traffic platforms in multi-site / multi-country contexts, where consistent contracts and data transformations are essential. I have designed and implemented workflows that harmonize heterogeneous models (CRM/ERP and partner integrations), introduced contract-first APIs and validation pipelines, and owned production concerns (observability, incident-driven improvements, CI/CD and deployments). This combination of pragmatic architecture and long-term ownership aligns closely with Alan’s approach: we build what we design, and we maintain what we ship.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Alan’s global-first transformation by designing cross-cutting modules that enable product teams to ship across markets with less friction, while preserving local flexibility. I am comfortable working in a written-first, radically transparent environment, collaborating across teams, and mentoring engineers with a focus on high-impact, cross-domain solutions.

Yours sincerely,
Franck Delahaye
